desc: The launcher (what Paper Cut.exe starts) with the program's memory under 4 GiB (TTYD_LOW_ADDRESSES, as Windows with bottom-up or high-entropy ASLR off): it opens and draws instead of stopping at the start-up check
log_must: ^\[memory\] TTYD_LOW_ADDRESSES: started with bottom-up and high-entropy ASLR off
the C heap at \S+ is under 2 GiB
